name: Large Tomb
desc1: This cavernous chamber's walls are covered with hundreds of intricate
desc2: frescoes depicting the turbulent history of Silvermere. The Heroes of
desc3: Silvermere can clearly be seen battling against the demonic forces of
desc4: the unnamed one. A mammoth stone sarcophagus rests on the floor in the
desc5: centre of the chamber, and a small altar stands at its feet. There is
desc6: a shimmering blue portal in the far wall.
